stem:
Charu stirs sugar into a glass of water until no sugar grains can be seen. She stirs sand into a second glass of water; the sand settles on the bottom.

Which claim correctly decides which mixture is a solution?

options.text: Sugar-water is a solution because its components are evenly distributed.
Sand-water is a solution because both mixtures were stirred.
Sugar-water is not a solution because sugar and water began as separate substances.
Sand-water is a solution because sand and water share one glass.

teacher.key_rationale: A solution has components evenly distributed. Sugar-water fits; settled sand-water does not.
